demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- State-level capital outlay on roads infrastructure recorded a CAGR of around 15% during FY21-FY25, with a strong pipeline of regional connectivity projects in key states; for FY26 and FY27, state capex growth is expected to outperform central spending.
- Central capex on National Highways projects has slowed due to muted project awarding and execution challenges over FY24 and FY25, with central outlays expected to remain muted in the near term.

capex_expansion.body: The company signed a Development Agreement for redevelopment of a society in Borivali near National Park on Western Express Highway ("Atlantaa Exotica") and has initiated the approval process, with construction expected to commence during the year. Construction at the existing "Atlantaa Enclave Phase II" project in Thane is progressing as planned toward completion. The company is also bidding for new redevelopment projects in Mumbai's Island city and western suburbs.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Expand presence in the EPC road infrastructure sector through a two-pronged approach: nominated contracts (as implementation partner leveraging technical expertise and execution capabilities) and competitive bidding for new EPC road projects.
- Maintain a balanced project portfolio by combining direct project acquisition through competitive bidding with strategic partnerships on already-awarded contracts.
- Pursue real estate redevelopment opportunities in Mumbai's Island city and western suburbs.
